title: Chalcogen-Rich Lanthanide Clusters from Lanthanide Halide Starting Materials: A New Approach to the Low-Temperature Synthesis of LnSx Solids from Molecular Precursors

material_class.structural_family: square Yb4 cluster with four edge-bridging disulfides and a μ4-sulfide cap

synthesis.procedure: Preferred route (Schlenk): Yb (0.380 g, 2.20 mmol), PhSSPh (0.479 g, 2.19 mmol), and I2 (0.279 g, 1.10 mmol) were combined in THF (20 mL) and stirred until the metal was consumed. Elemental S (0.159 g, 4.96 mmol) was added to the deep red solution. Within 1 h the mixture turned cloudy brown; after one day it was filtered, the red filtrate was reduced to about 10 mL and layered with hexane to give red crystals (0.372 g, 39%) that lose THF at 100 °C, darken at 175 °C, and eliminate a yellow oil at 225 °C. Anal. Calcd for C28H56O7I2S9Yb4: C, 19.3; H, 3.25. Found: C, 19.7; H, 3.31. Alternative from "YbI(SPh)": Yb (0.343 g, 1.98 mmol), PhSSPh (0.216 g, 0.989 mmol), I2 (0.251 g, 0.99 mmol), and S (0.143 g, 4.46 mmol) gave a similar yield. From YbI0.5(SPh)1.5: Yb (0.310 g, 1.79 mmol), PhSSPh (0.586 g, 2.69 mmol), I2 (0.114 g, 0.45 mmol), THF (30 mL), and S (0.129 g, 4.03 mmol) gave 1 (0.30 g, 38%). From YbI2: Yb (0.345 g, 1.99 mmol) and I2 (0.507 g, 4.00 mmol) in THF (40 mL), then S (0.064 g, 2.0 mmol), stirred 1 week; filtration, concentration to about 20 mL, and hexane layering gave about 20 mg of red crystals separated by hand. Main text also states 40% isolated yield from 2.25 equiv S with either "YbI(SPh)" or "YbI(SPh)2" in THF at room temperature.

reagents.name: ytterbium metal
reagents.amount: 0.380 g, 2.20 mmol (preferred route); also 0.343 g, 1.98 mmol; 0.310 g, 1.79 mmol; 0.345 g, 1.99 mmol

reagents.name: elemental sulfur
reagents.amount: 0.159 g, 4.96 mmol; also 0.143 g, 4.46 mmol; 0.129 g, 4.03 mmol; 0.064 g, 2.0 mmol; 2.25 equiv relative to Yb in the reported 40% route

synthesis.temperature: room temperature (reaction 2); crystals identified by low-temperature X-ray at -120 °C
synthesis.time: metal consumed, then 1 h to cloudy brown and 1 day before filtration (preferred route); 1 week for the YbI2 route
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques; solution reaction in THF followed by filtration, concentration, and hexane layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered to remove a small amount of brown precipitate; red filtrate reduced to about 10 mL and layered with hexane to give red crystals. YbI2 route: filtration, concentration to about 20 mL, hexane layering, and manual separation of about 20 mg of red crystals from lightly colored precipitate.
synthesis.yield: 0.372 g, 39% (preferred route); 0.30 g, 38% from YbI0.5(SPh)1.5; about 40% isolated yield stated in the main text; about 20 mg from YbI2

properties.summary: THF solution of 1 shows two unusually sharp visible absorption maxima assigned as (S-S)2- and S2- to Yb(III) charge-transfer excitations; these bands are absent for the Tm and Er analogues. No magnetic data are reported.

material_class.structural_family: square Ln4 cluster with four edge-bridging disulfides and a μ4-sulfide cap

synthesis.procedure: Prepared identically to 1. Tm (0.340 g, 2.01 mmol), PhSSPh (0.549 g, 2.51 mmol), I2 (0.127 g, 0.50 mmol), and Hg (0.030 g, 0.15 mmol) were mixed in THF (30 mL). Elemental S (0.165 g, 5.03 mmol) was added to the resultant pale green solution. Filtration and saturation gave colorless crystals (0.179 g, 21%) that begin to turn red at 205 °C, are dark brown by 230 °C, and show no further change up to 330 °C. Anal. Calcd for C28H56O7I2S9Tm4: C, 19.5; H, 3.28. Found: C, 18.7; H, 2.76. IR spectrum identical to 1. Unit cell (Mo Kα, -120 °C): monoclinic C2/c, a = 19.392(9) Å, b = 12.921(5) Å, c = 38.80(2) Å, β = 91.16(5)°, V = 9720(9) Å^3.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution synthesis in THF, described as identical to the preparation of 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration and saturation gave colorless crystals.

properties.summary: The visible charge-transfer absorptions of the Yb cluster at about 404 and 460 nm are absent for colorless 2. The IR spectrum matches 1. No magnetic data are reported.

synthesis.procedure: Footnote 15 states that in an identical fashion the Er cluster 3 gives light pink crystals in similar yield. Spectroscopic and melting properties are indistinguishable from the Tm compound except for the principal Ln(III) f-f electronic absorptions. No separate reagent masses or volumes are given for erbium. Unit cell (Mo Kα, -120 °C): monoclinic C2/c, a = 19.325(8) Å, b = 12.960(4) Å, c = 38.741(15) Å, β = 91.20(3)°, V = 9700(6) Å^3.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: described only as identical to the Tm/Yb preparation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Light pink crystals obtained in similar yield; crystallization details not separately reported.

properties.summary: The Yb charge-transfer bands near 404 and 460 nm are absent. Unlike the Tm analogue, 3 shows principal Er(III) f-f electronic absorptions, but wavelengths and intensities are not given. No magnetic data are reported.
